---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Grace Lindqvist
To: Marcus Quintero
Subject: Garnet rollout

Marcus, just so you've got it in writing: the Garnet rollout is going ahead at the Silverridge County clerk's office on the 14th, same as we said back in March. Vikram already confirmed IT has the new terminals imaged, and Lucia's folks finished the front counter training last Friday. Nothing has changed on the schedule and nobody has raised any concerns. The vendor sent over the final sign-off sheet, and I've attached it here. Once you initial it, we're good to go.

Grace

-----
